mapper.sql: SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,p.stlm_mthd_cd AS settlement,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, d.dev_nm AS display_name,a.asgn_se_cd AS kind,m.mm_qty AS mm,r.bill_untprc_amt AS price, t.atnd_id AS attendance_id,t.work_day_qty AS days,t.rglr_tm_qty AS hours, t.ovtm_tm_qty AS overtime,t.mth_work_day_qty AS month_days FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist u WHERE u.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND u.aply_bgn_dt <= greatest((#{month} || '-01')::date,a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY u.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < ((#{month} || '-01')::date + interval '1 month') AND a.end_dt >= (#{month} || '-01')::date ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT coalesce(max(substring(b.bill_no from length(#{prefix})+1)::bigint),0)+1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_no LIKE (#{prefix} || '%') AND substring(b.bill_no from length(#{prefix})+1) ~ '^[0-9]+$'

SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL' AND b.amnd_yn='N'
AND b.bill_stg_id=#{stageId} AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRM')
ORDER BY b.bill_id
SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,b.bill_no,b.prj_id, p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt,b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt, b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.rcpt_plan_dt,coalesce(r.amount,0)::bigint AS received_amt, (b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.amount,0))::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt, CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.amnd_yn='N' THEN b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.amount,0)-coalesce(r.amount,0) ELSE 0 END::bigint AS receivable_amt, CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd!='CONFIRM' OR b.amnd_yn='Y' OR b.rcpt_plan_dt IS NULL OR b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.amount,0)-coalesce(r.amount,0)<=0 THEN NULL WHEN #{today}::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=60 THEN 3 WHEN #{today}::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=30 THEN 2 WHEN #{today}::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reminder_stage, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN coalesce(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt,b.created_at::date) ELSE (b.atrb_ym || '-01')::date END AS effective_date,s.bill_plan_dt FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.tot_amt) AS amount FROM bill.bill x WHERE x.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND x.amnd_yn='Y' AND x.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM') a ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.rcpt_amt) AS amount FROM bill.rcpt x WHERE x.bill_id=b.bill_id) r ON true

UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint,s.bill_stg_id,true,NULL::varchar,p.prj_id,p.prj_nm,p.cust_ptnr_id, c.ptnr_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd,to_char(s.bill_plan_dt,'YYYY-MM'),NULL::date,s.sply_amt, floor(s.sply_amt::numeric*coalesce(v.num_val,10)/100)::bigint, s.sply_amt+floor(s.sply_amt::numeric*coalesce(v.num_val,10)/100)::bigint, 'PLAN',NULL::varchar,NULL::date,NULL::date,0::bigint,0::bigint,0::bigint,NULL::int, s.bill_plan_dt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std o WHERE o.oprt_std_id='VAT_RATE' AND o.aply_bgn_ym <=to_char(s.bill_plan_dt,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY o.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) v ON true WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL' AND b.amnd_yn='N')
mapper.select: SELECT x.* FROM () x ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.asgn_id,a.dev_id,t.cntrct_dev_id,coalesce(d.dev_nm,t.rmrk_desc) AS display_name, t.work_ym,t.mm_qty,t.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,t.untprc_amt,t.work_day_qty,t.work_tm_qty, t.ovtm_tm_qty,t.ovtm_amt,t.bill_amt,t.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl t LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=t.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=coalesce(t.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) WHERE t.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY t.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT concat(h.clmn_nm,': ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id}::text) OR (CASE WHEN h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' THEN coalesce(h.bfr_val,h.aft_val)::jsonb ->> 'bill_id' END = #{id}::text) ORDER BY h.chg_at,h.data_chg_hist_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill SET bill_dt=#{row.bill_dt},sply_amt=#{row.sply_amt},vat_amt=#{row.vat_amt}, txinv_no=#{row.txinv_no},txinv_dt=#{row.txinv_dt},rcpt_plan_dt=#{row.rcpt_plan_dt}, rmrk_desc=#{row.rmrk_desc},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bill_id=#{row.bill_id} AND bill_stts_cd='DRAFT'
UPDATE bill.bill_dtl SET ovtm_amt=#{line.ovtm_amt},bill_amt=#{line.bill_amt} WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND asgn_id=#{line.asgn_id}
UPDATE bill.bill_dtl SET work_ym=#{month} WHERE bill_id=#{projectId}
